answer.text: A mandatory option that must be offered to clients, with no charges other than statutory charges

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that portfolio managers must offer clients the option of direct on-boarding, without intermediation by distributors, and that no charges may be levied other than statutory charges on this channel. The Trap: Direct on-boarding is neither prohibited nor restricted to particular investor segments; it must be made available to all PMS clients as a choice. Note: Where a distributor is involved, the fee arrangement and any commissions must be transparently disclosed; direct on-boarding is the cleaner, fee-transparent route for clients who prefer to deal with the portfolio manager directly.
